cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko

client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Upload stub file
with open('/workspace/project/extra_stubs.ts', 'r') as f:
    stub_code = f.read()

sftp = client.open_sftp()
with sftp.file('/tmp/extra_stubs.ts', 'w') as f:
    f.write(stub_code)
print("Uploaded stubs")

sftp.close()

# Append to ChunkSystem
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cat /tmp/extra_stubs.ts >> /opt/areloria/server/src/modules/world/ChunkSystem.ts")
print("Appended")

client.close()
EOF
